meta.note: Rockstar has NOT published an official trophy list. This list is the list as reported from PlayStation Network on 18 Nov 2026 (Exophase via PlanetGTA6, cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements). Names, official descriptions and grades below are reproduced exactly as reported; guide text is original. Anything not yet confirmed is labelled as such.
meta.title: Leonida Platinum — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no extra task of its own. Work through the roadmap stages in order: finish the story, then collectibles and activities, then the clean-up trophies, and finally 100% completion. Track your progress on this page; the bar at the top shows exactly how far along you are.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — it unlocks when you finish the mission named in the description. Story missions cannot be missed: just keep playing through the campaign in order and it will pop on completion.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unlocks when you finish Chapter 1 of the story. Before the chapter ends, make sure you have done Lucia's balcony meditation for the missable trophy 'Positive Mental Attitude' — that spot is reported to disappear after Chapter 1, and GTA VI has no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unlocks when you finish Chapter 2. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, as GTA VI has no mission replay — a habit that protects you if any later chapter-only content is discovered.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unlocks when you finish Chapter 3. Story chapter trophies come naturally from playing the campaign; there is nothing extra to do for this one.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unlocks when you finish Chapter 4. By this point in the story, keep your chapter-start manual save habit going and check the missable trophy 'Positive Mental Attitude' is still on track.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Unlocks when you finish the final story mission. Make a manual save BEFORE starting the final mission — GTA VI has no mission replay, and a pre-finale save is the safety net if any endgame-only content is discovered later. After the credits, free roam continues for clean-up.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — it unlocks when you finish the mission named in the description. Play through the campaign and it will pop; story missions cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: A story heist trophy — it unlocks when you finish the mission named in the description. Heist missions are part of the main campaign, so just play through and it will pop on completion.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — it unlocks when you finish the mission named in the description. Keep playing the campaign in order and it will pop.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — it unlocks when you finish the mission named in the description. Story missions cannot be missed, so it will pop as you play through the campaign.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — it unlocks when you finish the mission named in the description. Play through the campaign and it will pop on completion.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — it unlocks when you finish the mission named in the description. It will pop as you play through the campaign; nothing extra is needed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The big clean-up gold. 100% completion in GTA games means finishing the story plus a set checklist of missions, activities, collectibles and stunts — the in-game stats screen shows your percentage and what is still missing. Save this for last: most other trophies on this list feed into it. Check the in-game checklist regularly in the final stage so nothing is left at 99%.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and similar driving feats that the game counts as stunts. This is a grind best done passively: stunt whenever you drive, and it will climb on its own. In the clean-up stage, pick a fast car and chain stunt jumps on highways and ramps. Track the counter in the in-game stats if it is listed there.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one session of every activity type the game offers — races, shooting range, fishing, drone races, arcade games, bowling and anything else listed under activities. You do not need to win or finish them well; just try each one once. Do this early so you know which activities you enjoy before grinding their dedicated trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Head to a shooting range and earn gold in every challenge it offers. Use Combat Focus (slow-mo aim) to steady your shots, and learn each challenge's target pattern before going for gold — a few practice runs are cheaper than frustrated retries. Gold thresholds are usually generous once you know the layout; take your time and prioritise accuracy over speed.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each Top Fun location on the map. Learn the racing line for each course first — drone races reward clean cornering and cutting the gates tightly more than raw speed. If a location keeps beating you, retry it alone a few times to memorise the turns before going for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race list across Leonida: street races, off-road and whatever other series exist. A well-upgraded car suited to each race type helps more than raw driving skill; match the vehicle to the surface.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Fishing challenges usually reward steady reeling and keeping tension in the right zone — don't yank the line, and watch the tension meter. Find Cal at the fishing spots and accept his challenge when it appears.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine and finish one full game. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest or easiest one you find. Arcades are scattered around Vice City — check entertainment venues and bars.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: A character mission-strand trophy — it unlocks when you finish Andy's final mission. Character strands usually open as you progress the story; take Andy's missions whenever they appear on the map and the strand will conclude on its own.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: A character mission-strand trophy — it unlocks when you finish Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's strand whenever his missions appear; the trophy pops at the end of his storyline.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: A character mission-strand trophy — it unlocks when you finish Billy's final mission. Take Billy's missions as they appear on the map and the strand will wrap up with this trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the odd characters marked on the map with a question mark. Each strand is usually several missions long. Explore the whole map and talk to every stranger you find; the counter climbs as whole strands finish, not per mission. This pairs naturally with the exploration trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: A character mission-strand trophy — it unlocks when you finish Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's missions as they appear; the trophy pops when his strand concludes.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: A character mission-strand trophy — it unlocks when you finish Tyrone's final mission. Take Tyrone's missions whenever they show up and the strand will end with this trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY in the game as currently reported: Lucia's balcony meditation spot is only available in Chapter 1 — meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, or it is gone for that playthrough. The other spots are found across the map (look for quiet scenic viewpoints); meditate at each one and the trophy pops when the last spot is done. Because GTA VI has no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE — reported by PowerPyx / GTABase: Lucia's balcony meditation spot in Chapter 1 counts toward this trophy and disappears after that chapter. GTA VI has no mission replay, so meditate at the balcony spot during Chapter 1, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and one before the final mission.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a special hunting target rather than ordinary wildlife. Follow Bret's instructions to find the animal's territory, track it, and take the shot cleanly. Bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly; unique animals are usually one-shot opportunities.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when you have every card in it. Finish any 3 full sets. Cards are usually tucked into out-of-the-way spots — rooftops, alleys, interiors — so sweep each district methodically. Keep a checklist of which sets you have finished; this tracker counts them here.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK spots are spread all over the map, so this is a long grind — fold it into your exploration: WAiNK everywhere you go while working on other trophies, and the count will climb without dedicated grinding sessions.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's assorted mini-objectives (stunts, driving feats, combat feats and more). Challenges overlap heavily with other trophies, so many will complete themselves while you play. In clean-up, open the challenges menu, pick the easiest unfinished ones first, and work through them in batches.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Get to 4 stars (aggressive driving and shooting at police raises heat fast), then break line of sight — duck into alleys, switch vehicles, or hide until the wanted stars flash and clear. Do it with your partner present or it will not count.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level ever dropping to zero between them. Plan a route of 3 close-together shops, rob fast, and keep moving — the trick is speed between robberies, not firepower. Use a fast getaway car parked facing the exit, and avoid killing shopkeepers unnecessarily if that spikes the heat.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or enter new vehicle models and they count toward the total. Variety is the key: try every car, bike, boat and truck you see rather than sticking to one favourite. Parking lots, dealerships and traffic in different districts are the fastest way to find new models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill 5 enemies during one single activation of Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode). Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang shootout or a police ambush — and trigger Combat Focus when 5+ enemies are in view. Use an automatic weapon, aim for the head, and keep the focus active until the fifth target drops. If you run out of targets, retry in a busier fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). The description suggests leaving the airport in a way that was not scheduled — stealing a plane is the classic GTA move, and the airport is the natural place to try it. Head to VCIA, grab an aircraft on the tarmac, and take off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Rhinos are the military tanks of the GTA world, so this trophy involves them — getting inside one, or surviving a situation involving them, is the likely trigger. When the army shows up at high wanted levels, that is your window: steal a Rhino if you can, or deal with the tank encounter however the moment allows.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean — no alarms, no detection. Plan it like a stealth job: scope the store first, move quietly, take the goods and leave before anyone notices. If the alarm trips, leave and try again later rather than fighting your way out; a clean run is what counts.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Bank vaults are bigger jobs than shop robberies — bring your partner, a fast escape vehicle, and a route planned before you go in. Five successful vault jobs with a clean escape each time earns the silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it (ramming it or blocking the road works), grab the cash, and lose the wanted level. A sticky situation is best handled with a getaway car parked nearby and a quick exit from the area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida — the whole state, not just Vice City. Drive the highways, the coast, the swamps and the small towns; the in-game map tracks which areas you have discovered. Fold this into every other trophy: explore while doing stranger strands, WAiNK spots and card hunting, and it will complete itself.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation run by each gang in Leonida. Gangs control different rackets around the map — find an operation for each gang, rob it, and get out. Expect armed resistance: these are gang properties, so bring weapons and a fast car.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar or venue on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. This is a relaxing one — find the right spot on the beachfront, sit down with a drink, and the trophy pops. A good palate cleanser between heists.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass front — the classic GTA showroom smash. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build up speed on the approach, and drive right through it. Style points for doing it in something expensive.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a full game there. Any score counts; just finish the game at that specific alley. Find it on the map and book a lane.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership moment — this trophy's vague description suggests a story beat about Lucia and Jason's partnership reaching the public eye. It will most likely unlock through story play; keep playing the campaign and check this tracker as the story unfolds.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: A choices trophy — the game tracks decisions you make, and this one pops once a key choice (or set of choices) has been made. You cannot plan for a vague description like this: play the story, make your choices when prompted, and it will unlock when the game registers them.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something — retrying a failed mission, activity or challenge and passing it. If a mission or challenge fails, retry it right away and finish it; the trophy likely pops on that successful second try.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Something strange happens in Leonida — a weird event, easter egg or unexpected encounter. The honest guide for a trophy this vague: explore the map's odd corners, visit unusual locations at night, and investigate anything that looks out of place. It will most likely pop from a scripted strange encounter.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee weapon while driving by — a melee drive-by. Get a melee weapon, drive slowly past a pedestrian, and swing as you pass. It takes timing: too fast and you miss, too slow and you stop. A quiet street and a slow roll is the easiest setup.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs. This pairs with the robbery trophies — rob, launder, repeat.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food, anything that costs money. It adds up fast if you buy gear and vehicles as you play; big purchases like cars and properties count too. By the late game this usually completes itself, or buy a few expensive items in clean-up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available for purchase. Garages cost money, so save up — this is a late-game purchase once heist money is coming in. Check the property listings on the in-game real estate sites and buy each garage as it becomes available.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one — ten different vehicles in total. Variety helps: register whatever you find while exploring, and this completes itself during normal play.
trophies.name: On the Spot
